tools.name: idosell_get_shop_config
tools.description: Get the panel configuration: owner company data, languages, base currency, warehouses (stocks) and shops with their ids. Good first call to learn shop ids and warehouse ids. API: GET /system/config.

tools.name: idosell_search_orders
tools.description: Search orders by status, date range, customer, order ids or serial numbers. Returns order details with products, payments, dispatch data and the customer. Read-only (a POST search). API: POST /orders/orders/search.

tools.name: idosell_get_orders
tools.description: Get orders by order ids or serial numbers (give at least one). Use idosell_search_orders for filters. API: GET /orders/orders.

tools.name: idosell_list_order_statuses
tools.description: List the order statuses configured in the panel, with their ids and names. API: GET /orders/statuses.

tools.name: idosell_get_order_packages
tools.description: Get the parcels (shipments) of orders: courier, tracking numbers and status. API: GET /orders/packages.

tools.name: idosell_search_products
tools.description: Search products by text, code, availability, visibility or promotion. Returns prices, stock summary, images and categories. Read-only (a POST search). API: POST /products/products/search.

tools.name: idosell_get_product_stocks
tools.description: Get stock quantities per warehouse and size for products. API: GET /products/stocks.

tools.name: idosell_list_categories
tools.description: List the product categories of the shop with ids and names. API: GET /products/categories.

tools.name: idosell_list_brands
tools.description: List the brands (producers) of the shop with ids and names. API: GET /products/brands.

tools.name: idosell_search_customers
tools.description: Find customer accounts by text (name, e-mail, login), ids or active state. Returns contact data, addresses, balances and consents. API: GET /clients/clients.

tools.name: idosell_list_returns
tools.description: List returns issued for orders, filterable by order serial number, return id or status id. API: GET /returns/returns.

tools.name: idosell_list_couriers
tools.description: List the couriers available for a country, and whether each one handles pickup points. API: GET /couriers/couriers.

tools.name: idosell_set_order_status
tools.description: WRITE: change the status of one order (for example to packed, ready or canceled). Setting the same status again has no further effect. The panel may send customer e-mails for some status changes. API: PUT /orders/orders.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: idosell_search_orders, idosell_search_products · Private data: idosell_search_customers · Public sink: idosell_search_orders, idosell_search_products, idosell_set_order_status.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: idosell_search_orders, idosell_search_products · Private data: idosell_search_customers · Public sink: idosell_search_orders, idosell_search_products, idosell_set_order_status

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
